zed.why: W and R each spawn a Shadow that mimics Q and E from its own position 'regardless of range', so a single Q/E cast can hit the dummy up to three times (Zed plus up to two simultaneously-active shadows with different lifespans) - a real pet-attack-multiplier, not independent pet damage. R then stores a share of all damage Zed AND his shadows deal for 3 seconds and detonates it as one hit, so it has to sum across that multiplied output. Energy is also a genuine constraint here (W's passive exists specifically to refund it), unlike an ordinary mana kit.
